The structure of Zr6Nb4Co2 (reduced formula Zr3Nb2Co) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mcm (No. 143), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Nb each adopt 10-neighbor environments, while Zr centers have 15 geometric neighbors, and the neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Co and Nb polyhedra, and edge sharing among Co and among Nb polyhedra.
